published.citation: Croll et al. 2010, dayside brightness temperature at 2.146 µm (NASA Exoplanet Archive emission table): 1731 +/- 60 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010ApJ...718..920C/abstract

temperature.note: Its day side's brightness temperature is measured in secondary eclipse at 2.146 µm (3.58m Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (CFHT) at Mauna Kea Observatory Wide-field Infrared Camera (WIRCam)) and nobody has imaged it, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
temperature.chosen: 1 measured of 6 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
temperature.facility: 3.58m Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (CFHT) at Mauna Kea Observatory Wide-field Infrared Camera (WIRCam)
